targetClauses.resolutionCriteria: Classify the facets of the local correlation polytope for general numbers of parties, settings and outcomes.

formulation.notation:
| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $N$ | Number of (spatially separated) subsystems on which measurements are performed |
| $M$ | Number of alternative observables measurable on each subsystem |
| $K$ | Number of possible outcomes per observable |
| $(N,M,K)$ | The triple specifying the correlation scenario |
| $(MK)^N$ | Total number of joint probabilities arising from $M^N$ experimental setups, each with $K^N$ outcomes |
| $K^{NM}$ | Number of deterministic local-hidden-variable extreme points (one value of $K$ assigned to each of the $NM$ observables) |
| $A_i, B_j$ | Dichotomic ($\pm 1$-valued) observables on the first/second subsystem (correlation-inequality form) |
| $\mathsf{E}(\cdot)$ | Expectation value of a product of dichotomic observables |
| $f$ | A candidate inequality vector (a face/Farkas vector) of the correlation polytope |
| $e_k$ | The $k$-th extreme point of the correlation polytope ($k=1,\ldots,R$) |
| CHSH | Clauser–Horne–Shimony–Holt inequality |
| GHZ | Greenberger–Horne–Zeilinger state |
| PPT | Positive partial transpose |
| LOCC | Local operations and classical communication |
| $\rho$ | A bipartite (or multipartite) quantum state |
| $\rho^{T_A}$ | Partial transpose of $\rho$ over Alice's subsystem |
